requirements.title: MAX argument restrictions
requirements.definition: All MAX arguments shall have the same integer, real, or character type and the same kind type parameter.

pending.MAX-arguments-same-type: Positive source controls call MAX with all-integer, all-real, and all-character argument lists; source-control mutations mix integer with real and character with integer and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MAX-arguments-integer-real-or-character: Positive source controls use integer, real, and character arguments; source-control mutations use logical and complex arguments and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.MAX-arguments-same-kind: Positive source controls use same-kind integer, real, and character arguments; source-control mutations mix available kinds within one type and claim no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: MAX result type, kind, and character length
requirements.definition: The MAX result has the same type and kind as the arguments, and character results have the length of the longest argument.

requirements.title: MAX selects the largest integer or exact real argument
requirements.definition: For integer and exactly representable real arguments, the MAX result value is that of the largest argument.

pending.MAX-integer-largest-argument: Use integer arguments including negative, zero, and positive values in different positions; assert MAX(-9,7,2)==7 and MAX(7,-9,2)==7, and mutate the argument order or intrinsic to MIN so the checks fail.
pending.MAX-real-largest-argument-exact: Use exactly representable real arguments -9.0, 7.0, and 2.0 initialized from opposite sentinels; assert the result equals 7.0 exactly and mutate the largest argument to 6.0 so the check fails.

requirements.title: MAX character ordering and shorter-selected extension
requirements.definition: For character arguments, MAX selects the value chosen by intrinsic relational operators using the applicable collating sequence and extends a selected shorter argument with blanks to the longest argument length.

pending.MAX-character-collation-selection: Use only default-character pairs whose order is guaranteed by 7.4.4.4: initialize results to nonmatching sentinels, assert MAX('A','B') == 'B' for alphabetical letters and MAX('1','9') == '9' for numeric digits, then mutate the selected argument or intrinsic to MIN so both ordering checks fail.
pending.MAX-character-selected-shorter-blank-ext: Use the guaranteed default-character order 'A' < 'B' from 7.4.4.4 with unequal lengths: assert LEN(MAX('B','AA')) == 2 before equality and assert the value is 'B ' with right blank extension. Mutate the selected shorter argument to 'A' so the extension and value checks fail.
